notFound.title: Member not found
notFound.hint: Pick another teammate on the left.

detail.selfActivityBanner: This is your own activity record. Your workspace admins can see it too.

admin.selfGuard: You can't change your own role or membership. Ask another admin — that rule is what stops the last admin locking everyone, including themselves, out of the workspace.

role.title: Role
role.hint: Admins can invite people, manage members and see the audit trail. Changing a role signs the member out of every device so their new permissions take effect immediately.

access.title: Access
access.hint: Suspending keeps everything and can be undone at any time. Removing revokes the membership — their messages, tasks and history stay exactly where they are, and they can be re-invited later.

activeSessions.title: Active sessions
activeSessions.hint: Signing out a session ends it immediately — the device will need to sign in again.

admin.reactivateFirst: Reactivate this member before changing their role.

confirmDialog.removeMessage: <bold>{{name}}</bold> will lose access to this workspace immediately and disappear from the directory. Everything they wrote stays. You can invite them back at any time.
confirmDialog.suspendMessage: <bold>{{name}}</bold> will be signed out everywhere and won't be able to sign back in until you reactivate them. Nothing is deleted.

loadError.title: Sessions could not be loaded
loadError.hint: Check your connection and try again.

confirmDialog.title: Sign out this session?
confirmDialog.message: <bold>{{device}}</bold> will be signed out immediately and will need to sign in again.

header.title: Activity overview
header.subtitle: Time, sessions, and focus across apps and sites.

empty.title: No activity in this period
empty.hint: Charts appear once there is a day of activity to plot.

activeTimePerDay.title: Active time per day
activeTimePerDay.hint: Purple is time at the keyboard; grey is time signed in but idle.

whenTheyWork.title: When they work
whenTheyWork.hint: Darker means more active time in that hour.

error.title: Audit log could not be loaded
error.hint: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.hintScoped: Admin actions on this member will show up here.
empty.hintAll: Admin actions across the workspace show up here.

empty.title: No sessions recorded
empty.hint: Sessions appear here once they sign in from a device.

sessions.retentionNote: Showing the last 7 days. Older sessions are retained but not browsable here.

empty.title: No activity recorded yet
empty.hint: Activity appears here as they use {{brand}}.

timeline.retentionNote: Showing the last 7 days. Older activity is retained but not browsable here.

myActivity.title: Your activity
myActivity.subtitle: Everything {{brand}} records about how you work.
myActivity.whatsRecorded: What's recorded, and who can see it

bullets.signInOut: When you sign in and out, and when you're online, idle or offline.
bullets.appUsage: Which parts of {{brand}} you use, and for how long.
bullets.messagesAndTasks: Messages you send and tasks you act on — the first line of a message, never the whole conversation.
bullets.deviceAndLocation: The browser and device you sign in from, and a rough location from your IP.

myActivity.retentionNote: Your workspace admins can see this record. The last 7 days are shown here. Detailed activity is kept for 90 days and daily totals for longer — both are used for reports and are available on request, but are not browsable in the app.

membersEmpty.title: Members
membersEmpty.hint: Pick a teammate on the left to see their profile, or tap the chat icon to message them.
